system.description:
Your paracausal strength is inextricably linked to the rising dread in the universe.

You gain a resource called Echo. Your maximum Echo capacity is equal to your tier. At character creation you start with maximum Echo:

  • When you succeed on an action roll with Fear, gain an Echo.

  • When the GM uses a Fear feature of an adversary within Very Close range, gain an Echo.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist

system.gmNotes: Echo is gained by hand when either trigger happens; the playtest prints no rest refill.
